lead: An integer literal in an array-literal element position keeps `int`, whatever the array's declared element type says.
body: `array<uint> $u = [7, 8];` compiles with elements tagged `int`, while `[7 as uint, 8 as uint]` carries `uint` — `rule:types/numeric-literal-placement` applies at a parameter and a binding but not at an element. Convert in the literal whenever the tag is the subject; only a `callable`'s parameter-tag check observes it today.
